location.title: Location
location.description: Choose the location to monitor for nearby outages. You can use your Home Assistant home coordinates or enter custom coordinates.

override.title: Override Coordinates
override.description: Enter the latitude and longitude to use for outage monitoring.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Configure the search area and polling frequency. A test connection to the Xcel Energy outage endpoint will be performed before completing setup.

data_description.search_radius: Maximum distance from the chosen location to search for outages
data_description.poll_interval: How often to check for new outage data
